symptom.name: Machine does not drain or drains slowly
symptom.description: The washing machine does not drain or drains slowly and displays E1.

corrective_actions.name: Remove the blockage
corrective_actions.description: Remove the drain blockage and push Start/Pause once.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Remove the blockage. Push the Start/Pause button once.
corrective_actions.source_title: Haier LMA4120WBAB0 Automatic Washing Machine Service Manual

symptom.name: Display shows E4
symptom.description: The washing machine display shows E4.

failure_modes.name: Water inlet valve blocked
failure_modes.description: The water inlet valve is blocked.

corrective_actions.name: Clean the water inlet valve
corrective_actions.description: Clean the water inlet valve and restart operation.
corrective_actions.instruction_text: Clean the water inlet valve. Push the Start/Pause button once.
corrective_actions.source_title: Haier LMA4120WBAB0 Automatic Washing Machine Service Manual

symptom.name: No draining
symptom.description: The washer does not drain during rinse or spin.

failure_modes.name: Drain motor does not act when voltage exists
failure_modes.description: The drain motor does not act even though voltage exists at its terminals.

corrective_actions.name: Replace the drain motor
corrective_actions.source_title: Haier LMA4120WBAB0 Automatic Washing Machine Service Manual

symptom.name: Keep filling water
symptom.description: Water continues filling when it should not.

failure_modes.name: Water can fill into the water inlet valve without power
failure_modes.description: Water enters the water inlet valve with power off.

corrective_actions.name: Replace the water inlet valve
corrective_actions.source_title: Haier LMA4120WBAB0 Automatic Washing Machine Service Manual
